title: Change domain password
description: Changes the password of an Active Directory account using the current password, an NTLM hash or a Kerberos ticket (ccache). It also works when the account requires a password change at next logon.
warning: The new password must comply with the domain policy (length, complexity and history).

card.title: Account details
card.description: Enter the domain, the user and the passwords. The target can be the domain itself (which usually resolves to a domain controller) or a specific DC.

placeholders.kdcHost: KDC IP or hostname (empty = use the target/domain)
placeholders.target: DC IP or hostname (empty = use the domain)

help.ntlm: Format: LM:NT or the NT hash only.
help.ccache: The change uses the kpasswd protocol (RFC 3244). The ticket must be valid and the user/domain can be derived from the ccache.
help.target: If left empty, the provided domain will be used as the target.

validation.confirmMismatch: The new password confirmation does not match
validation.sameAsCurrent: The new password must be different from the current one

toast.ccacheReadError: Could not read the ccache file
toast.errorDescription503: Check that the provided domain/DC is reachable on the network.
